A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that the presence of Ascaris infection is a risk factor for the development of asthma in a cohort of patients with atopy and that this effect is independent of other risk factors for the development of the disease.

the presence of Ascaris lumbricoides infection may have a negative impact on the development of allergic diseases in a population with a high burden of parasitic infection.
